# Regression coefficients

```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(latex2exp)
library(brms)

setwd("experiment3")

source(file.path("..", "src", "model_diagnostics.r"))

models_path <- file.path("analysis", "brms_models")

exclude_models <- c(
    "STS-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2",
    "sgpt-bloom-7b1-msmarco",
    "stsb-xlm-r-multilingual",
    "stsb-roberta-base-v2"
)
```

```{r}
dataset <- "derco"

model_names <- list.files(models_path,
    full.names = FALSE,
    pattern = paste0(dataset, "_.*\\.rds$")
)
model_name <- model_names[1]

print(model_name)
m <- readRDS(file.path(models_path, model_name))
summary(m)
```

```{r}
plot(m)
plot(m, variable = "^b_", regex = TRUE)
plot(m, variable = "^sd", regex = TRUE)
```

```{r}
mcmc_plot(m, variable = "^b_[^Intercept]", regex = TRUE) +

```

## Summarize diagnostics across all models
```{r}
diagnostics_df <- data.frame()

for (dataset in c("derco", "tint")) {
    print(dataset)
    model_names <- list.files(models_path,
        full.names = FALSE,
        pattern = paste0(dataset, "_lp_.*\\.rds$")
    )
    for (model in model_names) {
        print(model)
        fit <- readRDS(
            file.path(models_path, model)
        )
        if (number_divergent_transitions(fit) > 0) {
            print(paste(
                "Divergent transistions! Number:",
                number_divergent_transitions(fit)
            ))
            divergent_trans <- TRUE
        } else {
            divergent_trans <- FALSE
        }
        diag <- diagnostics_rhat_ess(fit) |>
            mutate(
                "divergent_transitions" = divergent_trans,
                "dataset" = dataset,
                "model" = model
            )

        diagnostics_df <- rbind(diagnostics_df, diag)
    }
}
```

```{r}
diagnostics_df |>
    # group_by(dataset) |>
    filter(!str_detect(model, "SE_all")) |>
    summarize(
        "max_rhat" = max(max_rhat),
        "min_ess_bulk" = min(min_ess_bulk),
        "min_ess_tail" = min(min_ess_tail),
        "avg_ess" = mean(avg_ess)
    )

diagnostics_df |>
    # filter(min(min_ess_bulk) == min_ess_bulk) |>
    # filter(min(min_ess_tail) == min_ess_tail) |>
    filter(max(max_rhat) == max_rhat) |>
    select(model)

diagnostics_df |>
    filter(max_rhat >= 1.035) |>
    select(model, max_rhat)

diagnostics_df |>
    # filter(divergent_transitions) |>
    filter(max_rhat >= 1.035 | min_ess_bulk < 180 | min_ess_tail < 180) |>
    select(model)
```

## Plot effect of all models
```{r}
get_modelname <- function(text) {
    # remove implementation
    text <- str_remove(text, "CWE_")
    text <- str_remove(text, "WE_")
    text <- str_remove(text, "SE_")
    text <- str_remove(text, "sentences1_")
    text <- str_remove(text, "all_")
    # remove organization
    text <- str_remove(text, "Qwen_")
    text <- str_remove(text, "BAAI_")
    text <- str_remove(text, "intfloat_")
    text <- str_remove(text, "clips_")
    text <- str_remove(text, "Gameselo_")
    text <- str_remove(text, "jinaai_")
    return(text)
}

get_fixef_models <- function(
  datasets,
  model_prefix
) {
    for (dataset in datasets) {
        prefix <- paste0(dataset, "_", model_prefix, "_")

        model_names <- list.files(models_path,
            full.names = FALSE,
            pattern = paste0(prefix, ".*\\.rds$")
        )

        for (model_name in model_names) {
            if (str_detect(model_name, "bsemprior")) {
                next # skip extra priors for BF
            }
            implementation <- str_remove(model_name, paste0(prefix))
            implementation <- str_remove(implementation, ".rds")
            if (!str_starts(implementation, "SE|WE|CWE")) {
                if (!str_detect(model_prefix, "local")) {
                    next
                }
            }

            print(model_name)
            m <- readRDS(file.path(models_path, model_name))
            if (number_divergent_transitions(m) > 0) {
                print("Divergent transitions - skips this model")
                next
            }

            fe_df <- fixef(m) |>
                as.data.frame()
            fe_df$coefficient <- rownames(fe_df)
            fe_df <- fe_df |>
                mutate(
                    "implementation" = implementation,
                    "dataset" = dataset,
                    "model" = get_modelname(implementation),
                    "context" = case_when(
                        str_detect(implementation, "sentences1_") ~ "Sentence(N=1)",
                        str_detect(implementation, "all_") ~ "All",
                        .default = "Sentence(N=10)"
                    )
                )

            if (exists("fixef_df_")) {
                fixef_df_ <- rbind(fixef_df_, fe_df)
            } else {
                fixef_df_ <- fe_df
            }
        }
    }
    return(fixef_df_)
}
```

### n400 ~ s_lp + s_sem
```{r}
rm(fixef_df)

fixef_df <- get_fixef_models(c("derco", "tint"), model_prefix = "lp")
```

coefficient for semantic association
```{r}
fixef_df |>
    filter(!model %in% exclude_models) |>
    filter(context == "Sentence(N=10)") |>
    filter(coefficient == "s_sem") |>
    mutate(model_type = case_when(
        str_detect(implementation, "SE") ~ "SE",
        str_detect(implementation, "CWE") ~ "CWE",
        str_detect(implementation, "WE") ~ "WE"
    )) |>
    mutate(
        dataset = case_when(
            dataset == "derco" ~ "DERCo",
            dataset == "tint" ~ "TiNT"
        ),
        implementation = paste(model_type, model, sep = ", ")
    ) |>
    filter(model_type %in% c("SE", "WE", "CWE")) |>
    mutate(
        model_type = factor(model_type, levels = c("SE", "WE", "CWE")),
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(y = implementation, color = model_type)) +
    geom_point(aes(x = Estimate)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
            "firebrick",
            "steelblue1",
            "steelblue4"
        )
    ) +
    facet_wrap(. ~ dataset, ncol = 1, scale = "free") +
    labs(
        x = TeX("$\\beta_2$"), y = "",
        color = "Embeddings"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file.path("figs", "regression_coefficients_sem.png"), height = 5, width = 7)
```

Plot for paper
```{r}
library(patchwork)

dataset_plot <- function(dataset_name, coefficient_name, y_lab, context_length = "Sentence(N=10)") {
    y_lim <- fixef_df |>
        filter(dataset == dataset_name) |>
        filter(context == context_length) |>
        filter(coefficient != "Intercept") |>
        summarize("min" = min(Q2.5), "max" = max(Q97.5))

    fixef_df |>
        filter(dataset == dataset_name) |>
        filter(context == context_length) |>
        filter(!model %in% exclude_models) |>
        filter(model != coefficient_name) |>
        filter(coefficient == coefficient_name) |>
        mutate(model_type = case_when(
            str_detect(implementation, "SE") ~ "SE",
            str_detect(implementation, "CWE") ~ "CWE",
            str_detect(implementation, "WE") ~ "WE"
        )) |>
        mutate(
            model_type = factor(model_type, levels = c("WE", "CWE", "SE")),
        ) |>
        mutate(
            implementation = paste(model_type, model, sep = ", "),
            coefficient = case_when(
                coefficient == "s_lp" ~ "Log-probability",
                coefficient == "s_sem" ~ "Semantic association"
            )
        ) |>
        arrange(model_type, model) |>
        mutate(
            implementation = factor(
                implementation,
                levels = unique(implementation)
            )
        ) |>
        ggplot(aes(x = implementation, color = model_type)) +
        geom_point(aes(y = Estimate)) +
        geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5)) +
        geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed") +
        scale_color_manual(
            values = c(
                "steelblue1",
                "steelblue4",
                "firebrick"
            )
        ) +
        ylim(c(y_lim$min, y_lim$max)) +
        facet_wrap(. ~ coefficient, ncol = 2, scale = "free_x") +
        labs(
            y = y_lab, x = "",
            color = "Embeddings",
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
            plot.title = element_text(size = 11),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)
        )
}

p_derco <- dataset_plot("derco", coefficient_name = "s_lp", y_lab = "") +
    labs(title = "DERCo") +
    dataset_plot("derco", coefficient_name = "s_sem", y_lab = "") +
    plot_layout(axes = "collect")

p_tint <- dataset_plot(
    "tint",

p_derco / p_tint +
```

### n400 ~ s_lp * s_sem

coefficients
```{r}
fixef_df |>

    filter(coefficient != "Intercept") |>
    mutate(model_type = case_when(
        str_detect(implementation, "SE") ~ "SE",
        str_detect(implementation, "CWE") ~ "CWE",
        str_detect(implementation, "WE") ~ "WE"
```
